security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://*.streetlifting.app wss://*.streetlifting.app; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'

bundle.longDescription: Streetlifting App — competition platform for streetlifting and weighted calisthenics. Browser-first, with offline-capable desktop client for tournament day.

updater._comment_pubkey: Reusing the v1.4.1 pubkey AE2CE39D47158968 to preserve auto-update continuity once V2 ships its first stable installer. Private half lives at ~/.tauri/streetlifting-os.key on the maintainer's host (NEVER commit) and is mirrored into TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY GitHub Actions secret. Endpoint is the new repo's releases. v1.x users continue to receive updates from the legacy repo via its own latest.json — they will be migrated via a final v1.x release that points to the V2 installer.
